image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a baby bib lying flat on a textured pink surface. The bib features a white central panel with blue and white striped trim around the neck and edges. It has an embroidered design in the center depicting a tiered cake or stack of items. The neck closure appears to be a tie made of the same striped fabric.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The embroidered design lacks clear thread definition; it appears slightly smudged or 'painted on' rather than having distinct raised stitches, which is a common AI artifact in rendering fine textile details.

The ties at the neck appear somewhat fused with the background and each other. The geometry of the knot/loop is ambiguous and lacks clear physical separation, suggesting slight structural incoherence.
The stripes on the trim waver slightly inconsistently along the curves, not perfectly following the geometric contour of the bias tape, indicating minor generation instability.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bib and not a similar textile item like a placemat or doily.
To verify the physical continuity of the trim and ensure the ties are distinct entities connected to the main body, checking for fusion artifacts.
To analyze the realism of the embroidered pattern and fabric weave, looking for smudging or unnatural texture repetition.

focus_areas: Integrity of the neck ties and their connection to the body
Realism and clarity of the embroidered central design
Consistency of the striped pattern along the curved trim
Distinction between the bib and the background surface
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the embroidered design; AI often struggles with rendering coherent text or complex small-scale embroidery, resulting in 'gibberish' shapes. Also, inspect the neck ties for logical knotting and separation from the background.
